alerts.subject: MSC replay recipe for next run
alerts.detail: POST /api/feature/tools/SearchSailingRoutes works on replay only via XMLHttpRequest with the X-Requested-With XMLHttpRequest header set. A plain fetch replay returns an empty string under HTTP 200. Body shape is FromDate, fromPortId, toPortId, language and dataSourceId, where dataSourceId is the brace-wrapped GUID E9CCBD25-6FBA-4C5C-85F6-FC4F9E5A931F. Port ids are opaque integers, not UN/LOCODEs: Yantian is 2, New York is 79. The response carries IsSuccess and Data, each entry keyed on MaritimeServiceName, PortOfLoading, PortOfDischarge and IsDirectRoute. Resolve and cache the remaining port ids to make MSC cheap next run.
